exposure: tenofovir disoproxil treatment for chronic HBV infection during pregnancy
cohort: A 27-year-old hepatitis B virus (HBV)-infected pregnant woman with a history of miscarriage.
finding: Treatment with tenofovir disoproxil in the 10th week of pregnancy led to undetectable HBV DNA, a normal pregnancy, and a healthy, HBsAg negative child at birth and after 3 months.
mod_finding: The patient gave birth by caesarean section.
